note_en: The pattern 一边……一边…… shows two actions happening at the same time: 一边翻烤串，一边跟镜头前的网友聊天 "flipping skewers while chatting with viewers on camera." English uses "while" or "-ing" for this, but Chinese puts 一边 before each verb, and both actions share the same subject. Compare 不管是……还是……，都…… "whether it's... or..., all..." in the second sentence, where 都 is required to sum up the list.
